group.label: Webhook Connection
group.comment: Where and how Montu receives the order events. Configure one endpoint and key pair per store view when the store views belong to different Montu stores.

field.label: Enable Webhook
field.comment: Master switch for sending order events to Montu. When off, nothing is recorded or sent.

field.label: Webhook Endpoint URL
field.comment: The URL where order events are sent. Example: https://events.montu.io/webhooks/magento/123 (ends with your store id)

field.label: Key ID
field.comment: Public key id issued by Montu (starts with kid_). Sent with every request as X-Montu-Key-Id.

field.label: Signing Secret
field.comment: Secret issued by Montu together with the Key ID. Signs every request (HMAC-SHA256) and keys the customer hashes; it is never sent over the network.
